dialogs.about: 저녁에 할아버지와 거실에서 볼 영화를 고름

lines.en: Let's watch a movie tonight.
lines.ko: 오늘 밤에 영화 한 편 봐요.

lines.en: Good idea. What is your favorite one?
The old one about a kind hero.
I watched it last winter. The ending is sad.
Then let's choose another movie.
How about the story from your novel?
Good. I finished the last chapter yesterday.
lines.ko: 좋아요. 어제 마지막 장을 다 읽었어요.

lines.en: Was the young character interesting?
Yes, very. I will read you a poem later.
lines.ko: 네, 아주요. 이따가 시도 한 편 읽어 줄게요.

lines.en: Thank you. I will make popcorn now.
Excuse me. Where are the new novels?
Hello. They are by the window, on the left.
Thank you. Is this one interesting?
Yes. The hero is a brave young woman.
Does the ending make people cry?
A little. I read the last chapter last night.
lines.ko: 조금요. 저는 어젯밤에 마지막 장을 읽었어요.

lines.en: My favorite books have happy endings.
lines.ko: 저는 결말이 따뜻한 책을 가장 좋아해요.

lines.en: Then try this book of short poems.
lines.ko: 그럼 이 짧은 시집을 읽어 보세요.

lines.en: I will read one poem every evening.
lines.ko: 매일 저녁에 시를 한 편씩 읽을게요.

lines.en: Wonderful. This novel will become a movie soon.
lines.ko: 좋아요. 이 소설은 곧 영화로 나올 거예요.
